authorization: User authorized deriving replacement rules and a current security reassessment from available specifications. This is implementation authority, not independent evidence, legal approval or an authenticated release waiver.
historicalStatus: Original SP-17–SP-20 wording and original SEC REP ONE remain unavailable. The following are explicit successor policies, not recovered historical text.

successorInvariants.name: Tenant boundary and least privilege
successorInvariants.rule: Every artifact, session, verification, consent and release operation must enforce its authenticated owner/tenant and scoped authority on the server. Unresolved ownership or authority denies the operation. Database-level tenant isolation is separately evidenced before claiming readiness that requires it.

successorInvariants.name: Honesty and hash-bound evidence
successorInvariants.rule: A claim, verification verdict or certificate must identify its real source, artifact version, verifier mechanism and evidence. Self-assessment is never represented as independent verification; missing or invalid evidence cannot become PASS. Changes invalidate reuse of evidence bound to an earlier version.

successorInvariants.name: Purpose-bound consent and corpus separation
successorInvariants.rule: Metadata audit, artifact sharing, marketplace supply, external evaluation and training/export are distinct purposes. No purpose implies another. Confidential or unconsented contents remain outside the corpus; training export requires the source's consent, ethics, split and human-approval gates, including withdrawal handling.

successorInvariants.name: Governed release and operational recovery
successorInvariants.rule: Every release route retains its required verification, custody, staged release, handoff and operate gates. Firmware retains MECHA. Missing or failed gates never imply clearance; waivers require authenticated scoped authority, reason and expiry. Recovery claims require observed version/traffic restoration, not a delivery receipt. Deferred controls are disclosed and do not count as satisfied.

sprintEligibilityRuling.certificationGate: Neither circuit is eligible without established certification of its source F4/F5 artifact version. Legacy flags, model scores and an advisory single-contract PASS are not substitutes.
sprintEligibilityRuling.regulatedGate: Regulated eligibility requires governed inclusion of Tracks H and C, not merely displaying their names or selecting a Regulated diagnostic option.
sprintEligibilityRuling.scTwoToolGate: Tools must be declared with their permissions in the SPC.
sprintEligibilityRuling.decision: Use the explicit SHORT SPRINTS v1.1 90-minute requirement as a conservative SC ONE eligibility ceiling; do not reclassify it as an original CELL hard law.
sprintEligibilityRuling.measurement: Elapsed MA build wall-clock time from the first F3 build start to completion of the F4 package, across retries and without clock resets. Exclude later verification-pack and release time. Resolve these boundaries from trusted server records, not an owner-entered estimate.
sprintEligibilityRuling.missingMeasurement: INCONCLUSIVE; do not substitute zero or authorize YES.
sprintEligibilityRuling.overLimit: SC ONE is ineligible; continue to F5/full route without losing prior work.
sprintEligibilityRuling.citationsCorrected: At most three prompts is CELL C-001 / CELL-04; one-tool limit is CELL C-004 / CELL-07. The 90-minute ceiling is this derived SC ONE policy, not MA-002.
sprintEligibilityRuling.scTwo: No build-time ceiling. The other SC TWO certification and configuration requirements remain.
